import pandas as pd

def load_and_transform_source(file_path):
    """
    Load a source CSV file, drop unwanted columns, and normalize user_id to lowercase.
    """
    # Read CSV
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Drop any columns not in target schema
    expected_columns = ['user_id', 'email', 'geo']
    df = df.loc[:, df.columns.isin(expected_columns)]
    
    # Normalize user_id to lowercase
    df['user_id'] = df['user_id'].str.lower()
    
    return df

def main():
    # List of source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/test_0.csv"
        # Add more source files here if needed
    ]
    
    # Load and transform all sources, then concatenate
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = load_and_transform_source(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)
    
    # Concatenate all dataframes
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Optional: Remove duplicates if any
    combined_df = combined_df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
